title: Use ExternalLink consistently instead of raw anchor tags in the dotcom client
reason: Child of #9189 proposing consistent use of the upstream ExternalLink wrapper for target-blank links. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The report concerns upstream dotcom links and does not establish a marketing-site defect.

title: Miscellaneous design-system cleanups in the dotcom client
reason: Child of #9189. The follow-up says almost all listed items were independently resolved, and a later maintainer update confirms all acceptance items on main, including removal of dead CSS and token replacements.

varveAssessment.assessment: Confirmed upstream resolution does not imply matching defects on Varve's site.

title: Audit and unify the border-radius scale in the dotcom client
reason: Requests an audit of a bounded upstream dotcom radius set, preserving deliberate pill, circular, and concentric uses rather than applying a blind replacement. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No local marketing-site radius audit is supported by this upstream-only task.

title: Tapping with a second finger while drawing on android tablet cancels the drawing
reason: Reports a second finger tap canceling an active draw on an Android tablet, contrasting with iPad pinch behavior. The reproduction details are incomplete and no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is a useful device-level interaction lead, but no Varve Android tablet reproduction was performed.

title: TlaButton variant=warning renders without warning styling
reason: The only comment confirms the warning variant and its admin call sites were removed as dead code in #9261, eliminating the reported no-op variant.

varveAssessment.assessment: Upstream component behavior is not part of Varve's site component system.

title: Flaky e2e: live-sharing scenario suite times out waiting for cross-client workspace sync
reason: Reports an intermittent timeout in a newly added upstream multi-client scenario while waiting for Zero synchronization and sidebar visibility. It concerns live sharing service infrastructure and test reliability.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no equivalent live workspace-sync path to validate from this report.

title: Unified immutable iterables usage
reason: Proposes using a consistent immutable iterable shape in an upstream eraser state and offers an example PR. No comments were available and the request is stylistic/API-specific.

varveAssessment.assessment: No concrete Varve correctness or performance defect is shown; changing data structures requires local evidence.

title: Localize the new-workspace welcome file via per-locale template variants
reason: Requests locale-specific variants for the seeded welcome file (#9203), with a proposed extension to workspace template configuration. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is upstream workspace onboarding work, not a localization issue in Varve's marketing site.

title: Toolbar dragging incorrectly selects pen tool
reason: Reports a temporary pen-tool selection while dragging a tool from the toolbar with a pen, with selection restored on release. Reproduction relies on a linked video and no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Potential pointer/toolbar regression lead; the attachment was not replayed and no Varve reproduction was performed.

title: Dragging over the style panel on mobile causes the page to scroll
reason: The report itself says the issue appears dotcom-only; the single comment says it could not be reproduced. No reliable cross-app defect is established.

varveAssessment.assessment: Do not attribute a dotcom-only, unreproduced scrolling report to Varve's marketing website.
